This unblocks the removal half of task 549c-032f-6cb0-4258. Scope confirmed against current origin/main: both schema fields + their two _as_str_list coercer entries, the two _scheduled deprecation rows, the # read-via: markers, and the docs/config.md + docs/user-guide.md entries.
